Laser-measured first-step levels in 248Cm (Kneip et al. 2022: 23083.19, 24747.71, 25287.08, 24997.81, 25029.14, 25580.02 cm-1, wavemeter systematic 0.12 cm-1) lie 0.3 to 1.3 cm-1 from the 244Cm table values (23083.822, 24748.797, 25287.770, 24996.962, 25029.460, 25581.306). The authors attribute the differences to the 248-244 isotope shift; note that 24997.81 is 0.85 cm-1 ABOVE the table value while the others are below. The 244Cm table energies are stored.
